_note: ClawHavoc / ClickFix: malicious skill metadata socially engineers the user (via the agent) to run a base64-encoded shell payload. Agent fetches a skill description; the result body lands as untrusted_tool_output. The new agent_as_intermediary_clickfix rule fires HIGH twice — once for base64-decode-to-shell, once for open-terminal-and-run (both shapes co-occur in a single skill, typical of the campaign). Plus the 4-event read→transform→write shape trips the spectral motif and Fiedler anomaly. Sources: Koi Security Feb 2 2026, BulwarkAI Feb 26 2026, Trend Micro Feb 23 2026.
